description: This file defines the WorkflowCollectionEditor class, which is a Java property editor used within the OpenMRS platform to convert string representations of workflow collections into actual workflow objects and vice versa. It handles parsing and serialization of program workflows associated with a specific program.

classes.name: WorkflowCollectionEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for converting string representations of workflow collections into actual ProgramWorkflow objects and vice versa, used within the OpenMRS platform for managing workflows related to a program.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Parses a string to set the collection of program workflows, updating their retired status and adding new workflows as needed based on the input string.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Serializes a collection of ProgramWorkflow objects into a string of the format 'programId:conceptId conceptId ...'.
